runs.text: Call me Ishmael, shipmate. Some years ago—never mind how long precisely—havin' little or no coin in me purse, and nothin' particular to interest me on the port, I thought I'd sail about a little and see the watery part o' the world. It be a way I have of drivin' off the spleen and regulatin' the circulation. Whenever I find meself growin' grim about the mouth; whenever it be a damp, drizzly November in me soul; whenever I find meself pausin' before coffin warehouses, and bringin' up the rear of every funeral I meet; and especially whenever me hypos get such an upper hand of me, that it takes a strong moral principle to keep me from steppin' onto the deck of the street, and knockin' folks' hats off—then, I reckon it be high time to get to sea as soon as I can, arr. This be me substitute for pistol and ball. With a fine flourish Cato throws himself upon his sword; I quietly take to the helm meself. There be nothin' surprisin' in this, matey. If they but knew it, almost all hands, some time or other, cherish very nearly the same feelin's toward the tide as I.
